_alb_priority_base_comment: Two ALB listener-rule priorities are claimed starting here (base=staging, base+1=prod) -- check `aws elbv2 describe-rules --listener-arn <alb_http_listener_arn>` for collisions before instantiating a second app and bump this if the block is taken.
_email_comment: Invitation emails go out via Amazon SES. sender must be an address on an SES-verified identity in aws_region (the ferrouslabs.co.uk domain identity is verified); Terraform grants the task role ses:SendEmail on that identity only.

email.legal: Entendex Ltd trading as Ferrous Labs · 1 Empire Mews, Streatham, London SW16 2BF

_platform_admin_comment: Addresses granted platform admin at their next sign-in (PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS -> app/auth/config.py). This is how a deployed environment gets admins without reaching the private RDS. Removing someone here does not demote them -- demote from Admin > Users.

shared_infra._comment: Known IDs for the shared VPC/ALB/ECS/RDS — see infra/docs/onboarding-runbook.md. These don't change per app; only product_name/container_port/domain above do.
